observations.statement: The complete eight-clause 3-CNF on three variables is unsatisfiable with conflict-graph alpha 7 but has exact Lovasz theta value 8 under the H093 normalization.

Adjoining one common positive literal to the same eight sign patterns gives a satisfiable eight-clause formula whose conflict graph also has exact theta value 8, producing the opposite-label collision required by H096.
The UNSAT-side rational primal matrix is invariant under the 48 signed-coordinate automorphisms and has exact spectrum 1/3 once, 1/6 three times, 1/18 three times, and zero seventeen times.
H096's existential finite collision is constructively discharged pending independent review; H099 isolates the standard disjoint-union step needed for an explicit infinite family.
H001-H004 and H070 are rejected as independent mechanisms because unrestricted polynomial transformers can solve SAT first and encode only the answer in the target object.
H019 is rejected because boundary-symbol count is not a resource measure until node syntax, denotation size, original-variable support, and composition semantics are fixed.
After the C013 terminal removals and six attack-born descendants, the live inventory remains ninety-three while terminal historical nodes increase from four to ten.

The deepest unresolved fronts after C013 are explicit mixed residual construction, local pseudoexpectation transport, DNNF transfer for typed interfaces, and the five major proof-complexity upper/lower-bound duels.
